get.description: Returns a page of top-level comments (pinned first, then by `sort`: newest first, or top = most net likes) with author display name and avatar. Replies are listed by GET /api/videos/:id/comments/:cid/replies. When the request is authenticated with a channelId header, isLiked/isDisliked reflect that channel's reactions. Held-for-review comments are included for their author and the video owner only. When comments are off the list is empty and commentSettings is `off`.

get.summary: List all sections for a channel
get.description:
🔓 **Authentication Optional**: This endpoint works without authentication but provides additional features when authenticated with a valid JWT token in the Authorization header (Bearer <token>).


        Retrieves all channel sections ordered by position (ascending).

        **Public Access:**
        - Public channels: All sections visible to everyone
        - Private channels: Only visible to channel owner (requires auth)

        **Filtering:**
        - Optional `type` query parameter to filter by section type

        **Pagination:**
        - Cursor-based pagination with configurable limit (default: 20, max: 50)

post.description:
🔒 **Authentication Required**: This endpoint requires a valid JWT token in the Authorization header (Bearer <token>).


        Creates a new section for organizing channel content.

        **Authorization:**
        - User must be authenticated
        - User must own the channel

        **Position:**
        - Automatically calculated as last position + 1
        - Use PATCH /sections/reorder to change order

        **Validation:**
        - Section type determines required fields
        - Content validation based on type

401.description: Unauthorized - missing or invalid authentication token

error.example: Missing or invalid Authorization header. Expected: Bearer <token>

get.summary: List channel sections with populated content
get.description:
🔓 **Authentication Optional**: This endpoint works without authentication but provides additional features when authenticated with a valid JWT token in the Authorization header (Bearer <token>).


        Retrieves all channel sections with auto-populated content for dynamic types.

        **Public Access:**
        - Public channels: All sections visible to everyone
        - Private channels: Only visible to channel owner (requires auth)

        **Auto-Population:**
        - recent_uploads: Latest videos from the channel
        - popular_uploads: Most viewed videos from the channel
        - liked_videos: Videos liked by the channel owner
        - subscribed_channels: Channels the user is subscribed to

        **Query Parameters:**
        - populate: Include populated content (videos/playlists/channels)
        - type: Filter by section type
        - limit: Maximum sections to return (default: 20, max: 50)

200.description: Successfully retrieved channel sections with content

get.description:
🔓 **Authentication Optional**: This endpoint works without authentication but provides additional features when authenticated with a valid JWT token in the Authorization header (Bearer <token>).


        Retrieves details of a specific channel section by ID.

        **Public Access:**
        - Public channels: Section visible to everyone
        - Private channels: Only visible to channel owner (requires auth)

put.description:
🔒 **Authentication Required**: This endpoint requires a valid JWT token in the Authorization header (Bearer <token>).


        Updates an existing channel section with partial data.

        **Authorization:**
        - User must be authenticated
        - User must own the channel

        **Notes:**
        - Partial update (only provided fields are updated)
        - Cannot change section type (delete and recreate instead)
        - Cannot change position (use PATCH /sections/reorder)

401.description: Unauthorized - missing or invalid authentication token

error.example: Missing or invalid Authorization header. Expected: Bearer <token>

delete.description:
🔒 **Authentication Required**: This endpoint requires a valid JWT token in the Authorization header (Bearer <token>).


        Deletes a channel section permanently.

        **Authorization:**
        - User must be authenticated
        - User must own the channel

        **Notes:**
        - Deletion is permanent and cannot be undone
        - Other sections' positions are automatically updated

401.description: Unauthorized - missing or invalid authentication token

error.example: Missing or invalid Authorization header. Expected: Bearer <token>

patch.description:
🔒 **Authentication Required**: This endpoint requires a valid JWT token in the Authorization header (Bearer <token>).


        Reorders all sections for a channel in a single atomic operation.

        **Authorization:**
        - User must be authenticated
        - User must own the channel

        **Validation:**
        - Must include ALL existing section IDs
        - No duplicates allowed
        - All IDs must exist and belong to channel

        **Atomicity:**
        - Either all sections reorder or none (rollback on error)

401.description: Unauthorized - missing or invalid authentication token

error.example: Missing or invalid Authorization header. Expected: Bearer <token>
